prices.source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly, nominal USD

manual.note: Entered by hand from published reports; never overwritten by scripts/build_feed.py. Add a line when a new report comes out, keep the source and date.

world_feed.source: Alltech Agri-Food Outlook 2026 (survey of 2025 feed production), as reported by Feed & Additive, April 2026

marine_ingredients.what: IFFO forecast for 2025: world fishmeal output about 5.4 million t and fish oil about 1.2 million t; to October, fishmeal up about 7 % and fish oil up about 5 % on 2024, Peru the main exception for oil yields

peru_anchovy.note: Peru's anchovy is the largest single source of fishmeal and fish oil; the North-Centre seasons matter most (first season April-July, second November-January). Quotas set by PRODUCE.
